    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Compile-time-only annotations an entry-point class uses to configure Juno's compilation, read directly from the class file rather than at runtime.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
    The board's own hardware and program-wide introspection: ArduinoUno and ArduinoNano hand out the board's pins, I2C bus, USB mouse, LED matrix, clock, BoardModel (which board the program was compiled for) and BoardMemory (Juno's arena and the program's flash usage).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.audio
    The board's audio output.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.carrier
    Pin maps for passive carrier boards a Nano plugs into, currently NanoConnectorCarrier: its microSD slot, Grove and Qwiic connectors are ordinary Nano header pins, so a carrier needs no compiler intrinsic of its own.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove
    Zero-allocation drivers and pin names for peripherals connected through the Grove Base Shield.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors
    Allocation-free Grove sensor drivers for digital, analog, I2C and infrared modules connected through the GroveBaseShield pin map.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.imu
    Motion sensing: NineAxisMotionShield, the orientation sensor of the Arduino 9 Axis Motion Shield, over I2c.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir
    Infrared serial transport: Infrared bit-bangs framed bytes over a 38 kHz IR receiver module and an IR LED on plain pins.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir.hx
    HX-53 emitter and HX-M121 receiver implementations of Juno's infrared transport interfaces: HX53InfraredEmitter and HXM121InfraredReceiver.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.kasa
    Allocation-free local-network control of legacy TP-Link Kasa HS100 and HS110 smart plugs.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.lcd
    Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.sd
    SPI SD-card access: SdCard, taken from the shield that holds the card's socket (such as the DataLoggerShield), opens files through an InputStream accepted by Juno's bounded intrinsic implementation of Properties.load(java.io.InputStream).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.servo
    Motor handles: Servo drives a standard 3-wire hobby servo through the Arduino Servo library, and PwmServoShield drives up to sixteen of them from a PCA9685 servo shield over I2C.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.tft
    Drivers for TFT display shields, currently TftTouchShield: the ELEGOO 2.8" 240x320 ILI9341 display on an 8-bit parallel bus, with a resistive touch panel and a microSD socket (its card is TftTouchShield.getSdCard()).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.wifi
    Wi-Fi shields, currently ArduinoWifiShield: the retired Arduino WiFi Shield, which gives the UNO R3 the Wifi it has no radio for.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.display
    Board displays.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.drive
    Board-independent motion coordination.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.gpio
    General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.hid
    USB HID mouse control: Mouse, which ArduinoUno.getMouse() hands out, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.i2c
    I2C register access: I2c reads and writes the registers of a peripheral on the board's primary I2C bus.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.imu
    Device-independent inertial sensing contracts.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
    The board's native implementations: the classes whose methods are compiler intrinsics.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.keyboard
    Board keyboards.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.led
    The built-in LED matrix of the UNO R4 WiFi (12x8) and the UNO Q (13x8): LedMatrix, the raw begin/loadFrame/clear operations that ArduinoUno.getLedMatrix() hands out, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][MAX_WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the board's matrix with show.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.motor
    Board-independent motor contracts.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net
    Wi-Fi connectivity for the UNO R4 WiFi, UNO Q, UNO WiFi Rev2 and the UNO R3 with the Arduino WiFi Shield: Wifi connects and reads the board's address.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.email
    Basic SMTP send / POP3S read built on Wifi's connection: Smtp to send a plain-text message to one recipient, and Pop3Client to report the mailbox message count and read the newest message's From/Subject and a bounded plain-text body into caller-owned buffers.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.http
    HTTP(S) client and server support built on Wifi's connection: HttpClient to send http:// and https:// requests into a caller-owned byte[] response buffer, Json to read typed values directly out of a response buffer without building a parsed document, and HttpServer (plain HTTP only) to serve requests, with HttpMethod/HttpStatus as named constants for both directions.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.tcp
    TCP over the board's Wi-Fi: Tcp gives a program one allocation-free connection with exact-length reads, for application protocols layered on top of it.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.udp
    UDP over the board's Wi-Fi: Udp gives a program one allocation-free socket for discovery broadcasts, datagrams to known peers and non-blocking receives, and SntpClock configures the SNTP server behind LocalDateTime.now(), which synchronizes on a socket of its own.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.power
    Battery and power-management APIs for supported boards.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.serial
    USB serial output: Serial and its BaudRate constants.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.time
    Time: Clock is the monotonic uptime clock, for measuring elapsed time without blocking.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf
    LEGO Power Functions infrared remote control.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup
    Remote control of LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth Low Energy, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx
    LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared remote control, brick commands, sensors, and firmware transfer.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.util
    General-purpose utilities: Delay blocks for a number of milliseconds or microseconds, Random provides seeded, bounded pseudorandom numbers backed by Arduino's generator, and UuidCodec converts supported UUID values to and from caller-owned 16-byte network representations.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.util.image
    Pre-rendered pictures drawn on the TFT by the example programs: the Java logo and the Arduino and M5Stack Cardputer boards.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.util.mvc
    A small model-view-controller toolkit for multi-screen programs on a TFT touch shield.
